name: dftracer_admin
description: Self-management of the dftracer MCP server a session talks to: server_status (stdio/http/zero-downtime worker, uptime, whether package code or skills/agents changed since start, supervisor generation/workers/last error/counters), server_reload (rolling restart under `dftracer-mcp-server start --ha`), server_refresh_content (re-link skills and agents), and a validator of a status report (dftracer_admin_check). Load after editing dftracer-agents tool code or skills and before relying on the change, or on 'not running under the zero-downtime supervisor', code_changed_since_start true, a supervisor last_error, or tools behaving like old code.

history.why: converted from dftracer-agents dftracer/admin_service.py (server_status/reload/refresh_content); no dedicated skill or agent existed
